scenario: A malicious phishing email is delivered and interacted with, followed minutes later by credential use from an unrecognized source and unauthorized account takeover activity.
required_evidence: A malicious phishing email is delivered to the employee.
The employee interacts with the phishing content.
The same account is subsequently used from an unrecognized source.
The credential use is associated with the recent phishing event.
Unauthorized account takeover activity follows the credential use.
forbidden_conclusions: Do not analyze the phishing event independently from the subsequent credential use.
Do not dismiss the unusual authentication without considering the preceding phishing activity.
Do not classify the account takeover as unrelated to the credential-use event without supporting evidence.

scoring_notes.correct_outcome: The system should recognize the sequence as a phishing-driven account takeover.
scoring_notes.evidence_requirement: The system should connect phishing delivery, user interaction, credential use, and takeover activity.
scoring_notes.uncertainty_requirement: High confidence is appropriate because the events form a coherent temporal attack chain.
scoring_notes.unsupported_claim_penalty: The system should not treat the events as unrelated when the timestamps and account context establish a clear progression.
